description: Un Grupo para poder resolver los desafios
summary: We developed MEDIC SPACE, an interactive software platform designed to monitor astronauts' health during space missions. The system uses biomedical sensors to collect physiological data and displays the information through real-time graphs and an interactive 3D anatomical model. Users can explore different parts of the body, review recorded measurements, and identify changes in vital signs. The project addresses the challenge of providing continuous health monitoring in environments where immediate medical assistance may be limited. MEDIC SPACE aims to support early detection of potential abnormalities, improve access to health information, and help astronauts and mission teams make timely and informed decisions.
details: MEDIC SPACE monitors astronauts' health during space missions through software that centralizes and displays their physiological parameters. Developed with Flutter and Dart, it allows users to view graphs and access individual medical histories. The system is designed to receive data from biomedical sensors through an ESP32 and a Wi-Fi connection, supporting the identification of potential abnormalities and the monitoring of each crew member. Its innovation combines an intuitive holographic interface with monitoring tools, prioritizing accessibility, privacy, and the ability to integrate new sensors in the future. This facilitates more organized and accessible health assessments during extended and demanding space operations.
